summary: Defines a framework for centralized conferencing, where participants on call signaling protocols such as SIP, H.323, or ISUP exchange media in a centralized unicast conference. It defines logical entities, naming, and the set of protocols that fit around them. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Many people on different phone systems can join one meeting hosted by a central server. This paper explains the parts and how they fit.
